confidence_notes: I based the restaurant, coffee and beer anchors on one search of aggregated cost-of-living sources: Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere, TravelTables, Expatistan and a 2026 Freenance guide. Numbeo gave about EUR 10.30 for an inexpensive meal, EUR 51.49 for a mid-range meal for two, EUR 3.70 for a cappuccino and EUR 3.43 for a domestic draft pint. Freenance put craft beer at 14-22 PLN. I converted euros at roughly the RBA AUD-USD to AUD-EUR cross rate of about 1.10 USD per EUR, then rounded up a little for July peak-season tourist pricing. I did not find direct aggregate prices for cocktails or wine. Those two use the local price relationship to beer and my general knowledge of Polish bars, about 35-40 PLN for a cocktail and 25 PLN for a glass of wine, so they are less certain. The accommodation anchors are my own estimates for Gdansk's July summer high season, not checked against any live listings, so they are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gdansk is a popular Baltic city with heavy summer tourism. I priced it slightly above the Polish average and similar to Krakow and the upper end of Wroclaw, but below Western European coastal cities.
